eps.d: The first ever show hosted by the dashing, intelligent, larger-than-life Vic Reeves with Bob Mortimer, Novelty Island and The Man with the Stick.
The surreal comedy series has a very special guest. Ladies and gentlemen it's Charles Darwin!
Vic meets a man who burns important documents, and demonstrates how to make a ray gun out of denim.
Vic is joined by a man who lives in a jam jar full of oil. And there's a special guest appearance from Les's pet jellyfish.
Vic is joined by a man who slithers to the sound of Morse code and another chap who flatters Brie. And there's an appearance from Mr Dennis, a dour confectioner.
Vic tussles with a rebel, demonstrates what to do with unwanted bark, and meets Mr Popkins and his lovey dovey doughnuts.

Intro: Song "We Plough The Fields And Scatter", brought on by Johnny Foreigner. Epsiode features Graham Lister, Morrissey The Consumer Monkey, The Ponderers, Talc & Turnips, 'Peter Gabriel' and 'David Bowie'.
Intro: Song "Help Me Make It Through The Night", brought on by Peanuts. Epsiode features Graham Lister, The Ponderers, Donald & Davey Stott's Chat Show with Uncle Pete.
Intro: Song "Stay With Me", brought on by Ayers Rock. Epsiode features Aromatherapists, "I Remember Punk Rock" song, The Ponderers and Judge Nutmeg with "That's Conciliation"
Intro: Song "Panic", brought on by Lovejoy. Epsiode features Graham Lister, Judith Grant, 'Barry Sheen', The Ponderers, Action Image Exchange and 'Rick Hastley'.

Intro: Song "International Bright Young Thing", brought on by Brigitte Nielsen. Epsiode features stretched Les, Man With The Stick's song, Talc & Turnips, 'Barbara Streisland', Wavy Davy, Mr Dennis and Graham Lister.
Intro: Song "The 'In' Crowd", brought on by MC Hammer. Epsiode features Les and his bontempi organ, Morrissey The Consumer Monkey, Tinkers Rucksack and Vic's Dancing Corncobs.

Intro: Song "The Grand Old Duke Of York", brought on by Reeves & Mortimer Brass Band. Epsiode features Bob's new desk, Greg Mitchell, Man With The Stick's caged kids, The Living Carpets, Professor Brian Chadwick with Piltdown Man, The Ponderers, Judge Nutmeg with "That's Justice".

Intro: Song "Little Bit Of Love", brought on by Leonard Cohen. Epsiode features Man With The Stick finally goes barmy and turns to drink, Greg Mitchell, Graham Lister hosts Novelty Island, Judith Grant, The Ponderers, Wavy Davy's real identity is revealed, Donald & Davey Stott present "Film 82", bombshell ending with multiple deaths.
